
== Japanese Premiere printing ==
The collecting encyclopedia, pp. 97-100, index 4101, confirms this Light Side, black-border, nonfoil Character publication and rarity. p. 41 dates its Japanese Limited edition to April 1997. <ref name="encyclopedia-172-premiere">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97-100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The English display name and printing ID <code>1301_29o</code> follow the approved identity mapping. The source index is not the printing ID. Missing data: a verified full-resolution Japanese card face; Japanese printed title, lore, game text, subtype, uniqueness, symbols and statistics; translation and wording comparison. The product illustration on p. 41 is not used as a verified full-card transcription source in this batch. No native-title alias, gameplay-equivalence claim or GEMP implementation claim is made. The cited preserved PDF was opened and its bytes verified against the source PDF. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] (7 November 2026, UTC).
